title: Travel: John Lennon – New York City to Los Angeles | 1970
content:
John Lennon and Yoko Ono flew from New York City to Los Angeles on 29 December 1970.

They had arrived in New York on 1 December, on a visa which allowed Lennon to stay no longer than “thirty days on business in New York and Los Angeles only”. With their time in the US almost up, they took the SS President Cleveland liner to Japan the following day.
